title: epic-reconciler/env.d.ts comments still name the serialized publisher as future work
body: src/epic-reconciler.ts's module header and src/env.d.ts's TICFAC_INTEGRATION doc both say integration waits on 'the serialized publisher (this phase's item 3) and the sandbox executor (item 4)'. ef7 landed the publisher, so the recorded boundary is now stale: integration waits on the executor only. I left these two comment sites untouched because the recorded decision they cite is z23's, and rewording a recorded decision is a reviewer's call, not mine.
